'''2011 Bespin Regionals Cooleo LS Tatooine: Cantina''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cooleo]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Oh He's Not Dead... Just out of Play
* '''Username:''' Cooleo1c
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
